newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish July core inflation unchanged yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish July core inflation unchanged yr/yr.

text.p: Finnish core inflation was unchanged year-on-year in July after rising 0.1 percent in June, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Monday.
The mean of six economists' forecasts for the July core inflation figure was a 0.2 percent rise in a 0.1-0.3 percent range.
The Bank of Finland's target for the year-on-year change in the underlying rate of inflation -- the central bank's chief gauge for monetary policy -- is a rise of no more than around two percent.
